subject.title: fix(mattermost): bound websocket handshake waits at 30s

question: Should Mattermost enforce an unconditional 30-second WebSocket opening-handshake ceiling, causing slower handshakes to fail and enter the reconnect loop?
rationale: Source, upstream contract, tests, and standalone proof establish the mechanism, but choosing the fixed availability threshold is an operator-impact policy decision that automated review cannot settle.

options.title: Accept the 30-second ceiling
options.body: Land the internal timeout as proposed, matching existing sibling precedent while avoiding another config option.

options.title: Choose another internal ceiling
options.body: Request a different fixed threshold based on supported Mattermost deployment characteristics, retaining the same narrow implementation boundary.

options.title: Keep handshakes unbounded
options.body: Decline the change until production evidence demonstrates that stalled upgrades are more harmful than aborting exceptionally slow valid handshakes.

recommendation.title: Accept the 30-second ceiling
recommendation.body: Land the internal timeout as proposed, matching existing sibling precedent while avoiding another config option.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work owns the Mattermost reconnect and close-before-open behavior directly affected by this timeout policy.
